triggers: choosing one Metal GEMM kernel for all shapes
an MMA kernel loses to a scalar tile kernel at small m

payload.goal: Dispatch per shape instead of crowning one GEMM kernel.

problem.statement: A single promoted kernel for every shape leaves large gains on the table in both regimes.

payload.what: On M5 Max, the 64x64 four-simdgroup MMA kernel wins 3.2x at m=1024 (q4 GEMM n=5376/21504, k=5376) but LOSES to the 16x16 scalar tile kernel at m=16 (0.473 vs 0.797 ms). Dispatch m>=512 to the MMA kernel and m<=32 to the small tile; both regimes stay correctness-green.
payload.when: Operators with widely varying m (prefill vs decode) hitting the same quantized GEMM.
payload.how: Promote candidates per shape regime with ABBA blocks; keep a dispatch table keyed by m threshold; re-validate thresholds on each new chip generation.
caveats: threshold measured only at m in {16, 1024}; the m=17..511 middle regime is unmeasured

raw.seed: onyx-infer kernel-agent/q4-mma episodes E1-E8, ABBA-measured on Apple M5 Max (Mac17,14, Metal 4, metalfe-32023.921.6), 2026-11-17

metrics.source: ABBA 2-block alternation, onyx-infer kernel-agent episodes E1-E8, M5 Max
